sections.tips: **Mẹo nhớ:** học mẫu **person + who/that + clause** cùng một câu hoàn chỉnh. Sau đó đổi chủ ngữ, thời điểm và dạng câu để thấy phần nào phải thay đổi.

rules.case: Chọn cấu trúc theo ý nghĩa
rules.example: The woman who called is my aunt.

rules.case: Kiểm tra thành phần theo sau
rules.example: This is the book that I mentioned.

rules.rule: Nguyên âm tiếng Anh gồm a, e, i, o, u; các chữ cái còn lại thường là phụ âm. Phân biệt này quan trọng khi thêm hậu tố hoặc chọn a/an.
rules.example: study → studies (d là phụ âm); play → plays (a là nguyên âm)

rules.case: Giữ sự hòa hợp và đúng dạng động từ
rules.example: The café where we met has closed.

usage.en: The woman who called is my aunt.
usage.vi: Người phụ nữ đã gọi điện là dì của tôi.
usage.label: WHO — bổ nghĩa cho danh từ chỉ người

usage.en: This is the book that I mentioned.
usage.vi: Đây là cuốn sách mà tôi đã nhắc đến.
usage.label: THAT / WHICH — bổ nghĩa cho danh từ chỉ vật

usage.en: The café where we met has closed.
usage.vi: Quán cà phê nơi chúng ta gặp nhau đã đóng cửa.
usage.label: WHERE — bổ nghĩa cho danh từ chỉ nơi chốn

usage.en: Students whose work is late must email me.
usage.vi: Những học sinh nộp bài muộn phải email cho tôi.
usage.label: WHOSE — chỉ sự sở hữu

usage.en: The film (that) we watched was great.
usage.vi: Bộ phim (mà) chúng tôi xem rất hay.
usage.label: Lược bỏ đại từ quan hệ khi nó làm tân ngữ

formula.note: S = chủ ngữ; V = động từ nguyên thể; V3 = quá khứ phân từ; V-ing = dạng động từ thêm -ing. Luôn kiểm tra chủ ngữ, thời điểm và ý nghĩa trước khi chọn mẫu.

examples.note: Ví dụ 2: minh họa cách dùng và vị trí cấu trúc trong câu.

mistakes.wrong: The man which lives here is kind.
mistakes.right: The man who lives here is kind.
mistakes.why: Chỉ người dùng who, không dùng which.

mistakes.wrong: The book who I read was good.
mistakes.right: The book which I read was good.
mistakes.why: Chỉ vật dùng which/that, không dùng who.

mistakes.wrong: This is the house where I live in it.
mistakes.right: This is the house where I live.
mistakes.why: Where đã thay cho "in which" — không lặp giới từ/đại từ.

mistakes.wrong: The keys that we were looking for them are here.
mistakes.right: The keys that we were looking for are here.
mistakes.why: That đã làm tân ngữ — không lặp them thừa.

sections.comparison: **Mệnh đề quan hệ xác định vs không xác định:** Xác định = thông tin THIẾT YẾU để hiểu danh từ, KHÔNG dấu phẩy (*The woman who called is my aunt* — bỏ đi thì không rõ ai). Không xác định = thông tin THÊM, đặt giữa dấu phẩy, bỏ vẫn hiểu (*My aunt, who called yesterday, is a doctor*).
sections.definition: Relative Clauses dùng **mệnh đề quan hệ** để bổ sung thông tin cho danh từ mà không phải mở câu mới. Bài học tập trung vào **ý nghĩa**, **cấu trúc** và cách tránh lỗi dịch máy móc thường gặp ở người Việt.

exercises.q: People say that this castle is 500 years old.  →  It ____ that this castle is 500 years old.
exercises.fb: Kiểu It: It + is said + that, vế sau giữ nguyên

exercises.q: This chair is ____ (comfortable) than that one.
exercises.fb: comfortable dài → more + tính từ

exercises.q: Which is ____ (dangerous) animal in the world?
exercises.fb: in the world → nhất, dangerous dài nên the most

exercises.q: This exercise is ____ (easy) than that one.
exercises.fb: easy đuôi -y → bỏ y thêm -ier

exercises.q: It was ____ a cold night that the lake froze. (so / such)
exercises.fb: sau chỗ trống là a + adj + danh từ → such

exercises.q: He has ____ many friends that he is never alone. (so / such)
exercises.fb: many luôn đi với so

exercises.q: The man ____ is standing at the door is my father.
exercises.fb: the man = người → who

exercises.q: I like the picture ____ hangs on the wall.
exercises.fb: the picture = vật → which

exercises.q: Do you know the girl ____ brother won the race?
exercises.fb: sau chỗ trống là danh từ brother → whose

exercises.q: Hue, ____ is famous for its food, is my hometown.
exercises.fb: có phẩy + vật → which, cấm that

exercises.q: The people ____ live upstairs are very noisy.
exercises.fb: people = người → who

exercises.q: This is the dictionary ____ I borrowed from Lan.
exercises.fb: the dictionary = vật → which

exercises.q: Mr Hung, ____ son studies with me, is a driver.
exercises.fb: sau chỗ trống là danh từ son → whose

exercises.q: The house ____ roof is red belongs to my aunt.
exercises.fb: sau chỗ trống là danh từ roof → whose

exercises.q: The song ____ we heard on the radio is very old.
exercises.fb: the song = vật → which

exercises.q: Rút gọn: The man who is waiting outside wants to see you.
exercises.answer: The man waiting outside wants to see you.
exercises.fb: is waiting chủ động → waiting

exercises.q: Rút gọn: Neil Armstrong was the first man who walked on the Moon.
exercises.answer: Neil Armstrong was the first man to walk on the Moon.
exercises.fb: the first → dùng to V

exercises.q: Rút gọn: The people who live next door are very friendly.
exercises.answer: The people living next door are very friendly.
exercises.fb: live chủ động → living

exercises.q: Viết lại dùng in which: This is the house which my family lived in for ten years.
exercises.answer: This is the house in which my family lived for ten years.
exercises.fb: giới từ in lên trước which thì bỏ in ở cuối

exercises.q: Viết lại dùng what: I don't believe the thing which she told me.
exercises.answer: I don't believe what she told me.
exercises.fb: the thing which gộp lại thành what

exercises.q: Rút gọn: My father was the only person who noticed my mistake.
exercises.answer: My father was the only person to notice my mistake.
exercises.fb: the only → dùng to V

exercises.q: Viết lại dùng with whom: That is the friend who I often go to the cinema with.
exercises.answer: That is the friend with whom I often go to the cinema.
exercises.fb: giới từ with lên trước thì phải dùng whom

exercises.q: Đổi sang gián tiếp: He said: “Someone has stolen my bag.”
exercises.answer: He said (that) someone had stolen his bag.
exercises.fb: has stolen lùi thành had stolen

exercises.q: Đổi sang gián tiếp: She said: “We are learning English now.”
exercises.answer: She said (that) they were learning English then.
exercises.fb: are lùi thành were · now → then

exercises.q: Đổi sang gián tiếp: Huong said: “We are going to have a party next weekend.”
exercises.answer: Huong said (that) they were going to have a party the following weekend.
exercises.fb: are going to lùi thành were going to · next weekend → the following weekend

exercises.q: Who is that man standing ____ the school gate?
exercises.fb: cổng trường là một điểm → at

exercises.q: My friend wants to buy that new car ____ she doesn't have enough money.
exercises.fb: she doesn't have là chủ ngữ + động từ, ý trái ngược → although

exercises.q: The book ____ I borrowed from you is very interesting.  (A who · B whom · C which · D whose)
exercises.fb: Thay cho vật là quyển sách → which · buổi 13
